3490-5231-6996-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6996-8319.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

240-5470-6791-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

2829-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2829-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Repeat from step 3.

4311-5078-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1322-2457-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1619-2438-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3446-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

206-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2292-6972-7228.description:

When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1734-3175-6797.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5296-6972.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
If needed, repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Workhorse dies, It's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it due to its ability.
Reoeat.

3532-3594-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1805-4067-4823-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

1286-5147-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5147-5972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4365-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4365-5658-6245-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4365-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1251-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

575-2482-3470-4121.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

1257-2725-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Tideforce Elemental and Walking Atlas do not have summoning sickness.
1257-2725-4543.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Tideforce Elemental by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting the land from your hand to the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tideforce Elemental triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

2942-3011-4591.easyPrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Each opponent has a life total of 2 or greater.
2942-3011-4591.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to 3/2 their life total.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life, and you do not lose the game due to Platinum Angel.

719-2972-4694.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Dragon" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2972-4694.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a Dragon due to Xenograft.
Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 0/0 Dragon due to March of the Machines and Xenograft.
The Treasure dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.
